editorial:
Ever felt like love is just a giant headache? You will totally relate to the three main characters here. They are all terrified of commitment and can't stand the idea of being tied down. When they happen to end up in the same cafe, they start arguing about romance and realize they are all just as broken as each other. It is a lighthearted ride that captures that awkward feeling of trying to avoid your feelings while pretending you have it all figured out. The vibe is very relaxed and feels like a long chat with friends over coffee.

The acting is great because the chemistry between the leads feels real and snappy. You will love how the dialogue flows, though some parts of the story move a bit slow. If you are looking for a low-stress movie for a lazy Sunday, this is a perfect pick. It is a sweet story that reminds you it is okay to be a bit of a mess when it comes to dating.
endingExplained: After spending the movie fighting against their feelings, the three misfits finally stop lying to themselves. They realize that their fear of commitment was actually just a fear of being hurt. In the final scenes, they decide to take a leap of faith and try being open to love again. They leave the cafe not as enemies or skeptics, but as friends who are ready to give romance one more honest shot.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves rom-coms with a bit of a cynical twist.
